services.name: One Hour Kayak or Paddleboard Rental
services.desc: Online booking suggested Rates Single Kayak - $32.50 Tandem Kayak - $60.00 Tandem Kayak Plus - $65.00 Paddleboard - $26.00 Duration 1 Hour About Coming over on the ferry from Seattle or staying here on Bainbridge Island? services.desc: Online booking suggested Rates Single Kayak - $62.50 Tandem Kayak - $125.00 About Enjoy the wonderful paddling destination of Eagle Harbor by the evening light turned night. services.name: DISCOVER SCUBA
services.desc: Online booking suggested Rates Person - $99.99 must be 10 years of age or older About Dreaming of exploring the underwater environment of the Puget Sound (or somewhere more tropical) but don't know where to start, or if you'd even like SCUBA diving? Come experience the excitement and thrill of breathing underwater on SCUBA equipment in a safe, controlled environment! In this 2 hour class you will learn essential skills such as donning your SCUBA unit, clearing your mask, attaining neutral buoyancy and most importantly how to be safe and have a great time while diving within the confines of the pool. This is the perfect way to try out and experience SCUBA to see that you love it before

services.name: General Paddling Strokes
services.desc: Online booking suggested Rates Single Kayak - $99.00 Tandem Kayak - $198.00 About We will cover the basics of kayaks, paddles, life jackets, and safety equipment, as well as teach you how to get in and out of the kayak, paddle efficiently, and the various strokes employed. Part of the time will be spent discussing theory on the beach, but most of the time will be spent on the water practicing the strokes, taking in the sights, and getting technique critique. Prerequisite: None Duration 2

services.name: Harbor to Harbor Kayak Tour
services.desc: Online booking suggested Rates Single Kayak - $119.99 Tandem Kayak - $239.98 About Join us as we paddle and view the great scenery of Eagle Harbor along the shoreline to Blakely Harbor, the site of the old Pt. Blakely mill. We will point out numerous historical sites unique to the Island and Blakely harbor while experiencing the beauty of Northwest wildlife. Advance booking required! Please call us @ (206) 842-1980 if you have a large group and need more than 6 boats. Duration 4 Hours(dock to dock including briefings) These times may vary dependent on paddling

services.name: Rescue and Re-Entry
services.desc: Online booking suggested Rates Single Kayak - $99.00 About Come join us for this 2 Hour session in one of our harbors. This short course is designed to boost the confidence of the new paddler or rusty one, where we will teach, review, and fine-tune efficient sea kayak rescue and re-entry techniques. Duration 2
